SettingDescription: A rain-soaked fantasy port city powered by tide mills; no modern technology exists.
CurrentSituation: Three cargo ships are overdue after an unnatural fog rolled in.
TimeDescription: Late evening, first day of the autumn storm season

CanonicalFacts.Value: Appeared two nights ago and dampens ordinary lantern light.
The Lark, Meridian, and Saint Orra are overdue.
